newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican peso shoots higher, traders drop long dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Mexican peso shoots higher, traders drop long dlrs.

text.p: The Mexican peso opened sharply stronger on Friday as foreign investors rushed to shed long dollar positions on expectations the peso would advance further during the session.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart opened 4.5 and 4.1 firmer, respectively, at 7.7650/7.7750 and 7.7610/7.7710 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile begun trade 6.2 centavos improved at 7.7510/7.7610 per dollar.
